episode.title: Run to First!
episode.blurb: Coach Blooper hits the ball and runs to third base, stops on first base so fast he wobbles, and watches a butterfly in the field. Then he learns to run to first, run right through it, and get in ready position.

quiz.prompt: You hit the ball! Where do you run?

feedback.correct: Yes! Drop the bat and run to first base.
feedback.wrong: Oops, that's a blooper! Run to first base. It's on your right.

quiz.prompt: When you get to first base, what do you do?

feedback.correct: Zoom! Run right through it. Safe!
feedback.wrong: Coach tried that and wobbled! Run right through first base.

choices: Feet apart, knees bent, glove ready

feedback.correct: You're ready! Feet apart, knees bent, glove ready.
feedback.wrong: Butterflies are fun, but get ready: feet apart, knees bent, glove ready!

transcript.text: Coach Blooper is back! Today he's gonna hit the ball and run.
Watch this, team! Batter up!
Coach... your bat is upside down again!
Whoops! That's a blooper!
Coach takes a big breath, watches the ball, and swings!
I hit it! I hit it!
Now drop the bat and run! Run, Coach, run!
Coach! That's the other way! That's third base!
Oops! Blooper!
Here's the rule. After you hit the ball, drop the bat and run to first base.
Stand on home plate. First base is on your right.
You run to first, then second, then third, then all the way home!
First, second, third, home! It's a big square!
Okay, Coach. Run as fast as you can to first base.
Here I go! Zoom, zoom, zoom... and STOP!
Coach stopped so fast, he wobbled! At first base, you can run right through it. Don't slow down!
Run right through it. Here I go again!
Zoom! Right through the base! Safe!
Now Coach is playing in the field. Is he ready for the ball?
Ooh, look! A butterfly!
Coach! Get ready! The ball might come to you.
Okay! Feet apart... knees bent... glove ready! Like a superhero!
Here comes the ball... and Coach stops it! Great job, Coach!
Hit the ball and drop the bat,
Run to first, now how about that!
Run right through, don't stop or slow,
Get in ready, here we go!
Feet apart and knees bent low,
Coach Blooper says go, go, go!
Let's remember. Hit the ball and run to first. Run right through it. And in the field, get in ready position.
Run to first! Run right through! Get ready! See ya next time, team! Whoa!
Bye, everybody!
